name: vouchfx
description: Schema-aware authoring for vouchfx .e2e.yaml integration tests: completion, hover and inline validation driven by the frozen v1 JSON Schema.

vouchfx.schemaPath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path (or path relative to the workspace root) to a **v1-compatible copy of the composed vouchfx schema**. **Schema source precedence:** (1) live export from the engine CLI (`vouchfx schema`, after a bar-B `list --json` check) when `vouchfx.cliPath` is available; (2) this override when set; (3) the small **bundled offline fallback** (`src/schema/composed-schema.v1.json`, version-checked via `x-vouchfx-schema-version: v1`). Use this setting only when the CLI is unavailable and you need an internal/enterprise mirror of the same v1 schema — not for pointing at a divergent document. Leave empty to use the live engine or the bundled fallback. See the **vouchfx** Output channel for which source was chosen.

vouchfx.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `vouchfx` CLI. Used by the **Test Explorer** to run `*.e2e.yaml` scenarios **and** (on activation) to load the live composed schema via `schema` / `list --json` so YAML validation matches the installed engine (REQ-009). Defaults to `vouchfx` (resolved on your `PATH`). Set this to an absolute path when the CLI is not on `PATH`, or to select a specific build. Minimum engine for live schema: a CLI that provides `vouchfx schema` and bar-B catalogue fields on `list --json` (`requiredFields`, `optionalFields`, `captureSupported`, `familyIntent`). Each Test Explorer run spawns `<cliPath> run <file> --events <tempFile> --no-decorations`. If the CLI cannot be started for a run, items are marked **errored** (never silently passed).
